```{r include=FALSE}

library(readr)

library(estimatr)

Sys.setenv(lang = "en_US")
```

```{r}
save_path_entsoe_output <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Intra_day_instrumnet_motivation/ENTSOE/outputs/final'
setwd(save_path_entsoe_output)

first_stage_data <- read_parquet('first_stage_data.parquet')

capacity_fields <- c("Published.Unavailable.Capacity"          
,"Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity","Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity"        
,"Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity" ,"wind_solar_tot"                          
, "gen_tot", "Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity", "Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity",
"Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity", "Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
"Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity", "Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity",
"Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity", "Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
"Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity", "Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity"
)

#adjuster l'ordre de grandeur des indispos pour ne pas avoir des coefficients nuls
first_stage_data_clean <- first_stage_data%>%
  filter(is.finite(log_price_diff) & 
           is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))%>% 
   mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000)) %>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity
         )


```

Estimation after 2021 the REMIT publication policy




Dernier test, on utilise les unavailabilities calculées par le modèle de random forest.
Et l'on compare avec l'indispo déclarée

```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_real <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+ gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+as.factor(weekday)
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_real, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


m_real_published <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity  + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+as.factor(weekday)
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_real_published, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real_published <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))




```



```{r, results = 'asis'}

reg_table <- stargazer(m_real, m_real_published,
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_real, cl_se_real_published),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Predicted RF", "Predicted RF", "Limiting", "Limiting"),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Unavailable.Capacity', "Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity","Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
             'Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity', "Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",'gen_tot',
             "Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",'Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity',
             'Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity', "Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity")
)
 
```


With both for the post period to see any changes
I would like to see it on the whole period


On fait la même chose avec les dismissed

```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_basic_dismissed <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity  + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_basic_dismissed, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic_dismissed <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

# dummy for creneau
m_creneau_dismissed <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity  + gen_tot +
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+as.factor(weekday) as.factor(creneau) ,
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_creneau_dismissed, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_creneau_dismissed <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# use controls
# put a dummy for the number of the auction
# put a dummy for the creneau

# warning cannot put a dummy for date + creneau + auction
# full determination, no variation
m_control_dismissed <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) +
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_control_dismissed, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_control_dismissed <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

```


```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_basic_dismissed, m_creneau_dismissed, m_control_dismissed, 
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_basic_dismissed, cl_se_creneau_dismissed, cl_se_control_dismissed),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Timeslot FE", 'Timeslot + Auction FE'),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity', "Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
             'Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity', "Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",'gen_tot')
 )
```

Using it as additional variation
Dismissed are simply negative shocks to the capacity




```{r}
first_stage_data_clean_negative_variation <- first_stage_data_clean %>%
  mutate(Published.Tot.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity,
         Published.Tot.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity - Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Tot.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Tot.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity - Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity)
         

```
